test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which statement best summarises the passage?

options.text: Pregnant women are emotionally less vulnerable to fear.
Nurses should visit pregnant mothers regularly.
Community support is vital in the emotional development of a child.
Study on nurses have impact even after fifteen years.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes a study conducted by the University of Colorado in Denver.
 
• The study found that when nurses made regular visits to these mothers and continued to support them, significant benefits were observed.
 
• These benefits included the **children being emotionally less vulnerable to fear**, **learning languages sooner**, and **achieving higher mental development.**
 
• So, the passage highlights the **importance of community support in the emotional development of a child**.
 
• Hence, the summary of the passage is **"community support is vital in the emotional development of a child."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
